headline: Northern Fronts Trade Ground Amid Bitter Clashes Across Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Since the previous report, intense tactical engagements continue to grip the northern frontlines, led by relentless fighting in Weathered Expanse and Callahan's Passage. Weathered Expanse remains the central cauldron of the war, registering multiple base changes across the last two hours as Crow's Nest, Frostmarch, and Huntsfort endure steady contest. In Callahan's Passage, forces continue to trade positions around Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage amidst over twenty thousand combined casualties in the past day. Nevish Line maintains active pressure along its front, logging fresh base turnover near Blackcoat Way right up to the latest cutoff. Stlican Shelf remains divided with continued skirmishing over Fort Hoarfrost and Breaker Town, leaving one strategic position unoccupied in no-man's-land. Stonecradle and Linn of Mercy have experienced a brief cooling in casualty rates over recent hours following earlier heavy fighting, while Palantine Berm has settled after its morning base exchanges. Across the broader map, rear and southern territories report negligible combat activity.
